title: Fonts
summary: One clean neutral sans for everything, an italic serif for the odd accent word, and a small mono for subtitles under card titles. All bundled locally with open licences.
usage: Kit names: F.sans = Inter (UI text 500-700, the top caption line, giant numbers at 800), F.serif = "Instrument Serif Italic" (accent words and sub-lines; the file is the italic, so set font-style normal), F.mono = "JetBrains Mono" (tiny subtitles, URLs, counters in chips), F.tight = "Inter Tight" (tracked small capitals labels).

items.note: Theme face: the top caption line, card titles, chips, giant ticking numbers (800).
Small widely tracked capitals for labels above numbers (STARS ON GITHUB).
Accent words in the caption line and italic sub-lines under numbers.
Tiny subtitles under card titles, URLs and terminal-ish details.
